# Atelier Sweet Home

> Small workshop in Georgia for old private houses: reconstruction, home inspection, roofs, outdoor kitchens and canopies. Tbilisi, Kakheti and all of Georgia. Website in Russian, English and Georgian.

Contact: hello@ateliersweethome.ge, +995 555 12 82 31, WhatsApp https://wa.me/995555128231

## Services

- [Old house reconstruction](https://www.ateliersweethome.ge/en/reconstruction): reconstruction of old private houses in Georgia.
- [Home inspection](https://www.ateliersweethome.ge/en/home-inspection): inspection of a house before purchase or repair.
- [Roofs](https://www.ateliersweethome.ge/en/roof): roof repair and replacement for old private homes.
- [Outdoor kitchens and canopies](https://www.ateliersweethome.ge/en/summer-kitchen): outdoor kitchens and canopies for private homes.
- [Contacts](https://www.ateliersweethome.ge/en/contacts): how to send a request.
